title: Hot host: master status and the Workers page show each session's test budget and the halved trial cap
description: With a CPU sensor at 96C (well over the trial cap's 85C halving limit) and three sessions running, one loop cycle records the test parallelism a session launched now gets, floor(cores / running sessions) and never below 2, and the merge writer's trial cap halved from 4 to 2. Master status shows both, and the Workers page shows them beside CPU pressure and temperature at 1280 px and 390 px.
